title: Offer alternatives to drag and drop

conditions: Alternative methods are important when drag and drop is inconvenient or impossible.
Menu commands can provide equivalent copy and move actions.

title: Provide continuous feedback throughout drag and drop

statement.en: Provide clear and continuous feedback throughout every drag-and-drop interaction.
statement.ja: すべてのdrag-and-drop interactionを通じて明確で継続的なfeedbackを提供する。

conditions: Drag and drop can produce multiple outcomes and people need to remain in control of the process.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Drag and drop experience on the scoped Apple platforms.

title: Update selection state after a drop

statement.en: After a drop, keep the dropped content selected in the destination and update source selection as needed.
statement.ja: drop後はdestinationでdropped contentのselectionを保ち、必要に応じてsource selectionを更新する。

conditions: For a same-container move, remove content from its original location.
For a same-container copy, deselect the content that remains at the original location.
For a drop into a different container, deselect the source content.
